atmo.o2Idlh: O2 at {reading}% is Immediately Dangerous to Life — EVACUATE, emergency rescue only with SCBA
atmo.o2DangerLow: O2 at {reading}% is dangerously low — DO NOT ENTER, ventilate immediately
atmo.o2DangerHigh: O2 at {reading}% is dangerously elevated — DO NOT ENTER, oxygen-enriched atmosphere increases fire/explosion risk
atmo.o2WarnLow: O2 at {reading}% is below the safe minimum of 19.5% — increase ventilation and retest
atmo.o2WarnHigh: O2 at {reading}% exceeds the safe maximum of 23.5% — identify oxygen source, ventilate and retest
atmo.lelIdlh: LEL at {reading}% is Immediately Dangerous to Life — EVACUATE, explosive atmosphere, emergency rescue only with SCBA
atmo.lelDanger: LEL at {reading}% is dangerously elevated — DO NOT ENTER, ventilate immediately
atmo.lelWarn: LEL at {reading}% exceeds the safe limit of 10% — increase ventilation and retest
atmo.coIdlh: CO at {reading} ppm is Immediately Dangerous to Life — EVACUATE, emergency rescue only with SCBA
atmo.coDanger: CO at {reading} ppm exceeds the NIOSH REL of 35 ppm — DO NOT ENTER, ventilate immediately
atmo.coWarn: CO at {reading} ppm exceeds the action level of 25 ppm — increase ventilation and retest before entry
atmo.h2sIdlh: H2S at {reading} ppm is Immediately Dangerous to Life — EVACUATE, emergency rescue only with SCBA
atmo.h2sDanger: H2S at {reading} ppm is dangerously elevated — DO NOT ENTER, ventilate immediately
atmo.h2sWarn: H2S at {reading} ppm exceeds the safe limit of 10 ppm — increase ventilation and retest
atmo.recMultiple: Multiple elevated readings suggest active atmospheric hazard — do not enter
atmo.recEnriched: Enriched oxygen atmosphere — fire/explosion risk, remove all ignition sources
atmo.recH2sZero: Chemical hazard listed but H2S is 0 — verify sensor calibration
atmo.recCoZero: Chemical hazard listed but CO is 0 — verify sensor calibration
atmo.recLelEnriched: Flammable gas detected in oxygen-enriched atmosphere — extreme explosion risk
atmo.recLowO2H2s: Low oxygen with H2S present — toxic gas may be displacing oxygen, do not enter without SCBA

jha.importDesc: Upload a task plan, method statement, or scope of work and Sage will extract the steps (advisory only — not a substitute for a competent safety assessment), hazards, and controls to pre-fill your JHA.

jha.stepsIntro: Break the job into the order you'll actually do it. List each step first — then let Sage help identify the hazards and controls for every step.
jha.stepPlaceholder: Step {n} — what is done in this part of the job?
jha.listStepFirst: List at least one task step first
jha.aiAdvisory: AI analysis is a starting point — review and edit before submitting for EHS review. AI suggestions are advisory and not a substitute for a competent safety assessment.
jha.matrixIntro: Rate risk by multiplying Severity (how bad) by Likelihood (how probable). Rate before controls to show inherent risk, then after controls to show residual risk.
jha.notesPlaceholder: Context from any meetings, special conditions, etc.

incident.title: Incident / Near-Miss Report
incident.reportingCulture: Report every incident — injury, near-miss, property, or environmental — as soon as you safely can, no matter how minor. At Mytra, reporting the small things is how we prevent the serious ones.
incident.seriousEscalation: This one also needs prompt escalation: notify your safety officer right away. Serious and critical events may trigger regulatory reporting — check your local requirements.

incident.aiAdvisory: AI suggestions are not a substitute for a competent incident investigation.
